questions.question_text:
Why is reproduction (Prajanan - Reproduction) essential for living organisms?
(सजीवों के लिए प्रजनन क्यों आवश्यक है?)
options: It keeps the individual organism alive. (यह जीव को जीवित रखता है।)
It fulfills their energy requirements. (यह उनकी ऊर्जा की आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करता है।)
It ensures the continuation of similar kinds of individuals generation after generation. (यह पीढ़ी दर पीढ़ी एक ही प्रकार के जीवों की निरंतरता सुनिश्चित करता है।)
It helps in the growth of the organism. (यह जीव की वृद्धि में मदद करता है।)
questions.answer: It ensures the continuation of similar kinds of individuals generation after generation. (यह पीढ़ी दर पीढ़ी एक ही प्रकार के जीवों की निरंतरता सुनिश्चित करता है।)
questions.explanation: Reproduction is not essential for the survival of an individual, unlike breathing or eating. Its main purpose is to maintain the continuity of the species (Santati) on Earth. (प्रजनन किसी व्यक्ति के जीवित रहने के लिए आवश्यक नहीं है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य पृथ्वी पर प्रजातियों की निरंतरता बनाए रखना है।)
questions.distractor_rationale: Option A is wrong because a living organism can survive its entire lifespan without reproducing. Option B is wrong as nutrition provides energy, not reproduction. Option D is wrong because growth happens through cell division in the body, not reproduction.

ai_context.learning_goal: Understand the fundamental purpose of reproduction for species survival.
common_misconceptions: Reproduction is needed for an individual to stay alive.
ai_context.hint: Think about whether a single animal will die if it never has babies, or if the whole species will disappear.

questions.question_text:
The type of reproduction involving the fusion of male and female gametes is known as:
(नर और मादा युग्मकों (Gametes) के संलयन (Fusion) से होने वाले प्रजनन को क्या कहते हैं?)
questions.explanation: In sexual reproduction, two parents are involved, and it requires the fusion of a male gamete (sperm) and a female gamete (egg/ovum) to form a zygote. (लैंगिक प्रजनन में दो माता-पिता शामिल होते हैं, और इसमें युग्मनज (Zygote) बनाने के लिए नर और मादा युग्मक का संलयन होता है।)
questions.distractor_rationale: Option A, C, and D are incorrect because they refer to modes of reproduction where only a single parent is involved and no fusion of gametes takes place.

ai_context.learning_goal: Identify the defining characteristic of sexual reproduction.
common_misconceptions: Sexual reproduction can happen with a single parent in animals.
ai_context.hint: The word 'sexual' involves two different sexes (male and female) combining their cells.

questions.question_text:
Which of the following animals exhibits external fertilization (Bahya Nishechan - External Fertilization)?
(निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जानवर बाह्य निषेचन (External fertilization) प्रदर्शित करता है?)
questions.explanation: Frogs lay their eggs in water, and the male deposits sperm over them. The fusion happens outside the female's body, which is called external fertilization. (मेंढक पानी में अंडे देते हैं और नर उन पर शुक्राणु छोड़ता है। संलयन मादा के शरीर के बाहर होता है, जिसे बाह्य निषेचन कहते हैं।)
questions.distractor_rationale: Hens, cows, and humans all have internal fertilization, where the sperm and egg fuse inside the female's body. Even though hens lay eggs, the fertilization itself happens internally before the eggshell is formed.

ai_context.learning_goal: Differentiate between internal and external fertilization with examples.
common_misconceptions: Animals that lay eggs always have external fertilization (e.g., hens).
ai_context.hint: Think about which of these animals lays soft, jelly-like eggs in the water where the male then fertilizes them.

questions.question_text:
Animals that give birth to young ones are called viviparous (Jarayuj - Viviparous). How can you often identify a viviparous mammal just by looking at it?
(जो जानवर बच्चों को जन्म देते हैं उन्हें जरायुज (Viviparous) कहा जाता है। आप अक्सर किसी जरायुज स्तनधारी को सिर्फ देखकर कैसे पहचान सकते हैं?)
options: They have scales on their body. (उनके शरीर पर शल्क (Scales) होते हैं।)
They have external ears and hair on their body. (उनके बाहरी कान और शरीर पर बाल होते हैं।)
They lay hard-shelled eggs. (वे कठोर खोल वाले अंडे देते हैं।)
They always live in water. (वे हमेशा पानी में रहते हैं।)
questions.answer: They have external ears and hair on their body. (उनके बाहरी कान और शरीर पर बाल होते हैं।)
questions.explanation: A general rule in biology (with few exceptions) is that animals with external ears (pinnae) and hair on their body are mammals, which give birth to live young ones (viviparous). (जीव विज्ञान में एक सामान्य नियम यह है कि बाहरी कान और शरीर पर बाल वाले जानवर स्तनधारी (Mammals) होते हैं, जो जीवित बच्चों को जन्म देते हैं।)
questions.distractor_rationale: Option A applies mostly to reptiles and fish. Option C describes oviparous animals like birds. Option D is incorrect because viviparous animals live on land (like humans, dogs) as well as in water (like whales).

ai_context.learning_goal: Connect physical traits to reproductive modes.
common_misconceptions: You cannot tell if an animal lays eggs or gives birth just by looking at it.
ai_context.hint: Look at yourself, dogs, and cats. What features do we have on the sides of our heads and covering our skin?

questions.question_text:
In which of the following organisms does reproduction take place through budding (Mukuln - Budding)?
(निम्नलिखित में से किस जीव में प्रजनन मुकुलन (Budding) के माध्यम से होता है?)
questions.explanation: Hydra reproduces asexually through a process called budding. A small bulge (bud) appears on the parent's body, grows, and eventually detaches to form a new individual. (हाइड्रा मुकुलन (Budding) नामक प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से अलैंगिक रूप से प्रजनन करता है। माता-पिता के शरीर पर एक छोटा उभार (Bud) दिखाई देता है, बढ़ता है, और अंततः एक नया जीव बनाने के लिए अलग हो जाता है।)
questions.distractor_rationale: Amoeba reproduces through binary fission, not budding. Humans and frogs reproduce sexually.

ai_context.learning_goal: Identify examples of asexual reproduction methods (Budding).
common_misconceptions: All microorganisms reproduce by splitting in half (binary fission).
ai_context.hint: Think of an organism that grows a tiny version of itself on its side, like a branch on a tree.
